tools.name: crypto-security_transaction-intent-verify
tools.description: Compare an EVM transaction's calldata and native value with the action declared in the request. Decoding uses the ABI in the request, or the standard ERC-20 transfer, transferFrom, approve, and increaseAllowance encodings when that selector matches. intent_match is true, false, or the string indeter

tools.name: crypto-security_intent-safety
tools.description: Read a caller-supplied EVM transaction or an EIP-712 typed-data message and describe the transfer, approval, permit, or outer call it encodes. Known selectors are transfer, transferFrom, approve, increaseAllowance, setApprovalForAll, permit, multicall, aggregate, and execute. The score is a local pe

tools.name: crypto-security_proxy-upgrade-storage-audit
tools.description: Compare the Solidity storage layout of an upgradeable implementation with a proposed replacement. Variables are matched by slot and offset, not by name. The types map is used for structs, mappings, dynamic arrays, and byte sizes. compatibility_status is compatible, incompatible, warnings, or indeter

tools.name: crypto-security_storage-slot-grade
tools.description: Compare two caller-supplied storage layouts by slot, offset, and size. A name that moves is a shift. Different names that occupy the same bytes are a collision. The grade and the collision score come from those counts. A variable is one slice of a single slot. No chain is queried. Price $0.04 USDC.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "crypto-security" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: crypto-security_transaction-intent-verify, crypto-security_intent-safety · Public sink: crypto-security_transaction-intent-verify, crypto-security_intent-safety, crypto-security_proxy-upgrade-storage-audit, crypto-security_storage-slot-grade · Destructive: crypto-security_transaction-intent-verify, crypto-security_intent-safety, crypto-security_proxy-upgrade-storage-audit, crypto-security_storage-slot-grade.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: crypto-security_transaction-intent-verify, crypto-security_intent-safety · Public sink: crypto-security_transaction-intent-verify, crypto-security_intent-safety, crypto-security_proxy-upgrade-storage-audit, crypto-security_storage-slot-grade · Destructive: crypto-security_transaction-intent-verify, crypto-security_intent-safety, crypto-security_proxy-upgrade-storage-audit, crypto-security_storage-slot-grade

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
